title: Minimax-Optimal Robust Identification of Continuous-Time Systems: Handling Narrow-Band Disturbances in the Frequency Domain
summary: The high-frequency spectral roll-off of continuous-time ARMA (CARMA) models can magnify the effect of narrow-band disturbances when aliasing is weak, making standard maximum-likelihood Whittle estimation sensitive to affected ordinates. We show that a logarithmic transformation $r_k = \log ρ_k$ converts the Whittle scale problem into a Gumbel location problem, connecting robust spectral estimation to the classical minimax theory of Huber and Rieder.
